tech.text: A target delivery is due around 09:00 on the Goods-in shelf. Book every vial in as soon as it arrives.
QC each new target vial (qc_check) and record the result.
Split every vial that passed QC into 45 µL aliquots in a new box in Freezer F80-1, then bin the empty vial.

scientist.text: BLI run for experiment EXP-08 (PD-L1) is booked on Gator 1 at 11:00. Prepare the target plate: a new BLI plate with 4 µL of PD-L1 target in each of wells A1 to H1, from the PD-L1 aliquots in Freezer F80-1. Use part-used aliquots first.
scientist.note: TP-00056 A1-H1 4 µL PD-L1 from ALQ-00013-002 (lot 7 spare)

scientist.text: For the same run, take 40 mL of BLI running buffer from Fridge R1 and 32 sensors from a sensor box on Shelf S1.
Put the PD-L1 aliquots you used back in their box in the -80, or bin any that are empty.
scientist.note: ALQ-00013-002 ~10 µL dead volume, binned and recorded

scientist.text: Priya (data reviewer) is planning a EGFR re-run for Thursday and needs to know how much EGFR target is usable. Find out and tell her.
scientist.note: Told Priya EGFR 15 full tubes ~525 µL usable, verified physically

scientist.text: The run ends at 15:00. The target plate is single use: bin it.

procurement.text: Check stock of EGFR and PD-L1 target and of BLI sensors; order what will run out within two weeks. The supplier cut-off is 12:00.
procurement.note: No order placed. EGFR has 15 full tubes plus one with 3 µL usable, and PD-L1 has 16 tubes (560 µL). Both match Marco's count and the new boxes BOX-00052 and BOX-00053. Marco says an EGFR run uses about 1 tube, so stock covers about 15 runs on each target. Sensors: 1,888, which is about 59 runs at 32 per run. Sara has not given the bookings by 11:08. Reorder if bookings pass about 14 runs on either target.

procurement.text: Check what expires in the next 14 days and tell Lena what to use first.
procurement.note: The only item expiring within 14 days is BUF-00049, which expires 14 Sep. Told Lena.

reviewer.text: Run EXP-06 failed QC on three designs. Plan a re-run for Thursday: check the expression plate, EGFR target and loading buffer are still usable then, and tell Marco what to prepare.
reviewer.note: EGFR lot 18 and BUF-00049 verified for Thursday. No EXP-06 expression plate found anywhere, so Marco was told to start fresh expression.
